mapper.sql: l.id, l.code, l.name, l.intro, l.direction, l.training_plan, l.requirements, l.contact, l.total_quota, l.status, l.created_at, l.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab l WHERE l.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM lab l WHERE l.code = #{code}
SELECT FROM lab l ORDER BY l.id
SELECT FROM lab l WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY l.id

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mentor m WHERE m.lab_id = l.id AND m.enabled = 1) AS mentor_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.application_id) FROM application_intent i WHERE i.batch_id = #{batchId} AND i.mentor_id IN (SELECT m2.id FROM mentor m2 WHERE m2.lab_id = l.id)) AS applicant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_assignment fa WHERE fa.batch_id = #{batchId} AND fa.lab_id = l.id AND fa.status != 'REVOKED') AS confirmed_count, (l.total_quota - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_assignment fa2 WHERE fa2.batch_id = #{batchId} AND fa2.lab_id = l.id AND fa2.status != 'REVOKED')) AS remaining_quota FROM lab l ORDER BY l.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab (code, name, intro, direction, training_plan, requirements, contact, total_quota, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{intro}, #{direction}, #{trainingPlan}, #{requirements}, #{contact}, #{totalQuota}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lab l WHERE l.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
